title: RepoCoder: Repository-Level Code Completion Through Iterative Retrieval and Generation
note: Abstract only; similarity-based retriever + iterative retrieval-generation, compared vs in-file/vanilla-RAG baselines, no budget-matched ablation stated.

title: A Review of Repository Level Prompting for LLMs
note: Full text; pure literature review contrasting RepoCoder (sliding-window/BM25/embedding retrieval) vs RLPG (signature/identifier-classifier prompt selection), no original experiments.

title: Dataflow-Guided Retrieval Augmentation for Repository-Level Code Completion
note: Abstract only; repo-specific dataflow/entity context graph retrieved for prompts, quantified gains vs SOTA, not stated as budget-matched.

title: Long Code Arena: a Set of Benchmarks for Long-Context Code Models
note: Full text; multi-task benchmark spanning raw-window, BM25/embedding retrieval (bug localization, API gen) and file-tree proximity heuristics (completion), quantified but not uniformly budget-matched.

title: ContextModule: Improving Code Completion via Repository-level Contextual Information
note: Full text; three co-primary context types (behavior-based raw code, similarity-retrieved snippets, static-analysis symbol defs) reported separately, no controlled ablation, differing token limits (4k/8k).

title: Prometheus: Towards Long-Horizon Codebase Navigation for Repository-Level Problem Solving
note: Full text; unified dependency knowledge graph traversed by LLM-directed agent with working memory; component-removal ablations (e.g. memory: 74.4%→56%) quantified, not budget-matched.

title: CodeRAG: Finding Relevant and Necessary Knowledge for Retrieval-Augmented Repository-Level Code Completion
note: Full text; AST-derived code chunks retrieved via combined sparse+dense+dataflow-guided multi-path retrieval and reranking; ablation adds paths progressively, conflating volume and method, not budget-matched.

title: MHRC-Bench: A Multilingual Hardware Repository-Level Code Completion benchmark
note: Full text; benchmark compares no-RAG raw-window baseline vs RepoCoder/RLCoder (similarity retrieval) vs GraphCoder (graph retrieval) all under a fixed 2,048-token input budget.

title: ContextBench: A Benchmark for Context Retrieval in Coding Agents
note: Full text; benchmark of coding agents using file-system navigation, embedding retrieval (Agentless), and graph retrieval (Prometheus), scored via recall/precision/F1, budgets/rounds vary naturally across agents.

title: RepoMirage: Probing Repository Context Reasoning in Code Agents with Perturbations
note: Full text; agents explore via shell/grep/cat commands over raw files, performance measured across semantics-preserving perturbations (66.8%→25.3%), step budget fixed but not context/token budget.

title: SWE-Review: Closing the Loop on Issue Resolution with Agentic Code Review
note: Full text; reviewer agent browses files/diffs/dependencies via shell tools in a generate-review-revise loop, quantified vs single-turn fixed-context baseline, explicitly no token-budget parity.

title: Beyond "What to Retrieve": Uncertainty in Retrieval-Augmented Code Generation
note: Full text; UniXcoder-embedded evidence (similar-code, repo context, APIs) filtered/ranked by learned uncertainty scores, 2^3 factorial source ablation under a common fixed prompt budget (max 10 items).
